about_the_game:
Montgomery Hills. A small, quiet town in Northern Ontario. The site of one of Canada's largest wildfires, started by one of the town's lifelong residents. The day he set the town on fire was the day he became the monster he is now. The residents who survived all ask the same question: Why? But answers come at a price in Montgomery Hills. He never speaks. He never sleeps. No one ever says his name. But the prisoner has a name and his name is Tom Dahl.

You are a rookie cop tasked with keeping watch over Tom Dahl's cell. Your eyes are heavy but you must keep yourself awake long enough to fulfill your duty. Officers swear that things change when they watch Tom. They say they can hear things. See things. There is only one rule with Tom Dahl: Watch him at all times. Survive Tom Dahl's twisted world by confronting the nightmares he creates for you and keep yourself awake long enough to see the light of a new day. Collect forgotten items around the station and speak with the other officers to uncover the truth behind one of Canada's biggest tragedies. He has already gotten out twice. There have already been "accidents". No one wants the job, but everyone has questions. However, the only question you'll be asking yourself is, "Who do you see?"
